directionality_note: H2_SUPPORTED uses a ONE-SIDED test (DEV rate must be higher than the chance/artifact nulls). H2_SUPPORTED_two_sided_reading uses a direction-agnostic test (DEV rate merely different from the nulls, in either direction). These can disagree - check per_year[<year>]['chance_direction'] to see whether any disagreement is because rates are elevated or suppressed relative to chance. Suppressed-vs-chance is itself a substantive finding (consistent with coders generally respecting Excludes1 rules) but is a different claim than H2 as originally framed.
note: All stability/negative-control thresholds in config.yaml are unverified placeholders pending literature-derived or committee-approved benchmarks - this verdict is only as trustworthy as those thresholds. DEVs are potential diagnostic-inconsistency signals, never confirmed misdiagnoses, regardless of this verdict.
